divergence at coding repeat loci in the form of both elevated
purity and extensive length polymorphism among different breeds.

Alx-4 (aristaless-like 4) and Runx-2 (runt-related transcription

differences in limb and skull morphology. We identified similar
repeat length variation in the coding repeats of Runx-2, Twist,
and Dlx-2 in several other species. The high frequency and
incremental effects of repeat length mutations provide molecular
explanations for swift, yet topologically conservative
